decision.rationale: current-step-only: retrieval is for tools inferable from the bounded current-step AdvisorContextV2 query. Each of the three implicit-secondary labels (table_filter@filesystem-semantic-013, write@verification-semantic-105, lsp_rename@research-semantic-125) is a grade-2 supporting-workflow step whose query is fully explained by a co-relevant sibling tool (read/coverage/summarize respectively) with zero descriptor, schema, or paraphrase cue for the labeled tool (M001 receipt sibling-explicit proof). Scoring all-plausible-workflow recall would therefore measure hidden workflow knowledge, not model signal. Graded recall is rejected because M001 preregistered no secondary weights, so reduced weight would not make an uninferable label inferable. The surviving gate-critical miss (glob@filesystem-semantic-003, query-paraphrase) is inferable and defines the precise Signal V2 gap to test.
